ws.role_template.student.name: Student
ws.role_template.student.description: A learning Workspace for genuine understanding rather than memorization. Diagnostics and Socratic questions help you form your own answers; active notes turn reading into claims, evidence, and questions. Build a semester map around deadlines, prerequisites, and mastery, choose only one to three achievable learning actions each day, and adjust workload and review intervals weekly using completion evidence and a misconception log. Includes Agents for study research, learning planning, and practice feedback. It does not do the work for you or fabricate learning evidence.
ws.role_template.scholar.name: Scholar
ws.role_template.scholar.description: A research Workspace that narrows broad topics into researchable, falsifiable questions with a clear contribution boundary. Build literature evidence tables with reproducible searches and inclusion criteria; synthesize evidence strength, disagreement, and gaps; organize papers around claim, evidence, and reasoning; verify that citations truly support each claim. During research design, check alignment across the question, design, sample, measurement, and conclusion, review bias and ethics risks, and capture environments and parameters for independent reruns. Includes Agents for literature review, research design review, and citation verification, with a strict no-fabrication policy.
ws.role_template.fde.name: FDE Delivery
ws.role_template.fde.description: A solution delivery Workspace that starts from the customer's business outcome to clarify the current state, data, systems, and constraints, while maintaining a ledger of facts and assumptions. Map outcomes to capability and architecture options, make non-functional requirements, tradeoffs, and the POC explicit, and design repeatable, signable acceptance evidence. Turn the solution into a delivery plan with clear responsibilities, dependencies, readiness gates, and rollback paths for both sides. Includes Agents for solution drafting, customer Context, and integration validation. It never invents interfaces or acceptance evidence.
ws.role_template.product_manager.name: Product Manager
ws.role_template.product_manager.descrip: A Product Management Workspace supporting the full path from requirements evidence to delivery review. Organize interviews, tickets, sales feedback, and other raw input into traceable evidence and problem themes; produce reviewable PRDs, user stories, and observable acceptance criteria from user journeys and product goals; use metric systems and prioritization frameworks for release tradeoffs; and study competitors and market signals to support positioning and differentiation. Includes Agents for PRD consistency checks, competitive research, and customer requirement assessment. Evidence is never fabricated, and unavailable data is never invented.
ws.role_template.project_manager.name: Project Manager
ws.role_template.project_manager.descrip: A Project Management Workspace that separates facts, decisions, and action items from meeting materials while preserving source evidence. Break ambiguous goals into a complete, testable WBS with clear owners, then create a predictable plan with dependency logic, capacity constraints, and a critical path. Produce decision-oriented status and forecasts from baselines and evidence, and maintain a RAID ledger with triggers, owners, mitigations, contingencies, and threshold-based escalation. Includes Agents for weekly status, project risk scanning, and project planning. Reports are based only on real evidence.
ws.role_template.technical_writer.name: Technical Writer
ws.role_template.technical_writer.descri: A Technical Writing Workspace that extracts a versioned, traceable fact ledger from code, specifications, and existing documentation. Design discoverable and extensible information architecture around audience tasks; maintain a glossary with definitions, aliases, prohibited terms, and approval history; turn user goals into executable, verifiable, accessible technical content; and identify affected assets, migration steps, and risks when versions change. Includes Agents for documentation consistency, source exploration, and change impact. It never invents interfaces or steps.
ws.role_template.recruiter.name: Recruiter
ws.role_template.recruiter.description: A Recruiting Workspace that turns hiring needs into an observable competency scorecard tied to business outcomes. Design consistent core questions and behavioral anchors around competency hypotheses; extract only explicit, traceable evidence from resumes; use a fixed rubric to build a requirement-to-evidence interpretation matrix that exposes gaps without automatically rejecting candidates; and preserve disagreements and evidence gaps when combining independent interview feedback. Includes Agents for hiring assessment gaps, batch resume parsing, and candidate comparison. It never ranks candidates for hiring automatically or infers unstated experience.
ws.role_template.software_engineer.name: Software Engineer
ws.role_template.software_engineer.descr: A Software Engineering Workspace that builds the smallest useful code map around the intended change instead of reading the entire repository by default. Map acceptance criteria to an ordered plan covering files, interfaces, data migration, tests, release, and rollback. Cover normal, boundary, error, permission, and recovery paths according to risk while retaining rerunnable test evidence. Find root causes through stable reproduction and single-variable experiments, then review changes for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. Includes Agents for codebase exploration, code quality review, and test execution. It never fabricates test results.
ws.role_template.ecommerce_ops.name: E-commerce Operations
ws.role_template.ecommerce_ops.descripti: An E-commerce Operations Workspace covering the full cycle from product selection to performance review. Identify promising products from market trends, competitor performance, and margin potential; analyze competitors' assortment, visual, and content strategies; compare prices across platforms to recommend pricing bands; turn selling points into product-page copy and Xiaohongshu posts; and periodically consolidate GMV, conversion, traffic, and advertising data to diagnose issues and recommend actions for the following week. Includes Agents for product selection analysis, content creation, and performance review. It never invents unavailable data.
